profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Office Identity and Connected Experiences
profile.summary:
I solve problems. Sometimes those problems pertain to software.

I have a GitHub account but it's mostly just Game Jam projects (and some of them are private): https://github.com/AntSharK

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Office 365 Identity
- Design, implement, and maintain components used by Office 365 Apps and Services to perform authentication and authorization. Responsible for the authentication experience of tens of millions of users daily.
- Delivered a component that works for variety of Apps and Services, all of them with multiple different business needs and technologies, while minimizing redundant work for all parties.
- Mostly C# for back-end components. A small amount of TypeScript for front-end components.

Office Shared Services
- Part of a team that develops and maintains critical middle-tier services within Microsoft Office. Work includes, but isn't limited to the following:
- Constantly identifying and improving performance to reduce cost (without wasting time with premature optimization).
- Investing in both passive and active monitoring to ensure problems are caught quickly.
- Services handle billions of requests daily, from hundreds of millions of users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Office 365 Suite - Identity Team.
- Dabbled in WebTest and WebDriver automation.
- Responsible for authentication experience in office.com
- Occasional forays into front-end land (JavaScript, TypeScript, Razer ASP.Net).
- Data-driven feature development (i.e. I use data to find out what our users are doing and develop features to enhance their experience)


Office Shared Services:
- Responsible for authentication and authorization across multiple Office 365 sites and services
- Part of a team that develops and maintains critical services within Microsoft Office, serving hundreds of millions of customers daily around the globe.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Intern at Amazon Web Services
- Developed Automated Integration Testing Framework

positions.title: Grader, CS 311 Algorithms
positions.description:
- Grader for CS311, undergraduate Algorithms course.
- Developed skills in garbled handwriting interpretation and intent guessing.

positions.title: Java Game Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutoring a small group of middle-school children to program in Java
- Incorporating elements of game programming to enhance learning experience

positions.title: Content Manager
positions.description:
- Handled content, social media, and interviews for team
- Created videos, articles, and in-depth game analysis
- Website received over 300,000 views in 3 months

positions.title: E-sports team leader
positions.description:
- Secured corporate sponsorship from HP and AMD
- Handled logistics, public relations, and resolved conflicts within team
- Planned and secured sponsorship for team to participate in competitions in Russia and Sweden

educations.fieldOfStudy: Higher Level: Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics
